entries.en: Was just thinking of you. Anyway, speaking of...
entries.ro: Mă gândeam la tine. Oricum, apropo...

entries.en: Well, well, well. Had a feeling you'd come.
entries.ro: Ei, ei, ei. Aveam un sentiment că o să vii.

entries.en: OK. We don't have to talk about it now.
entries.ro: OK. Nu trebuie să vorbim despre asta acum.

entries.en: What were we saying? Oh, right...
And they say I've got my head in the clouds. Earth to V!
entries.ro: Și zic că am capul în nori. Hei, V, ești pe pământ?

entries.en: Hey, that's not very nice, y'know?
Could you watch where you're going?
entries.ro: Ai putea să te uiți pe unde mergi?
